header.value: RasCustomScriptExecute is exported from the custom-scripting DLL
header.value_raw: RasCustomScriptExecute is exported from the custom-scripting DLL, and therefore is not defined in a header file.

parameters.description: Pointer to a Unicode RASDIALPARAMS structure. This structure contains the authentication credentials for the user. The custom-scripting DLL can modify the szUserName , szPassword , and szDomain members of this structure. The Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP) will use whatever is stored in these members when RasCustomScriptExecute returns.
parameters.name: pRasDialParams

parameters.description: Not used. Value always equals NULL.
parameters.name: pRasCustomScriptExtensions

parameters.name: hPort

parameters.description: Not used. Value always equals NULL.
parameters.name: lpszPhonebook

parameters.description: Pointer to a Unicode string that contains the name of the entry that was dialed to establish the connection.
parameters.name: lpszEntryName
